CALC.name: Calculated
CALC.description: Derived value generated by software or controller.

COUNTER.name: Counter
COUNTER.description: Monotonic runtime, cycle, volume or energy total.

TEXT.name: Text/status
TEXT.description: Diagnostic message, firmware, model or status detail.

quality_codes.good: Valid and within expected acquisition timing.
quality_codes.uncertain: Usable with caution; drift, estimated value, or stale-but-tolerable.
quality_codes.bad: Invalid, failed sensor, failed checksum, or out-of-physical-range.
quality_codes.stale: No update within the defined point timeout.
quality_codes.substituted: Replaced by fallback or manually entered value.
quality_codes.maintenance: Device intentionally unavailable or under test.

canonical_units.µmol/m²/s: micromoles per square metre per second

interlock_permissive.description: All required start/run permissives are satisfied.

fault_active.description: At least one active equipment fault.

current_dc_a.description: Signed DC current; direction convention stored in metadata.

power_factor.description: Signed or unsigned according to point metadata.

energy_available_kwh.description: Usable energy above current reserve floor.

priority_effective.description: Current priority after operator and process adjustments.

generator_start_request.description: Supervisory request to native generator control.

level_pct.description: Vessel level normalized to working range.

volume_estimated_l.description: Volume derived from geometry or calibration.

leak_active.description: Leak detector or leak model active.

work_order_open_count.description: Open work orders affecting the asset.

service_due.description: Maintenance service due by date, counter, or condition.

power_dc_input_kw.description: Inverter or converter DC input power.

power_ac_output_kw.description: Inverter, generator, or UPS AC output power.

current_a.description: Generic RMS or DC current as defined by binding.

power_import_kw.description: Imported active power using the configured direction convention.

power_export_kw.description: Exported active power using the configured direction convention.

breaker_trip_active.description: One or more associated breakers are tripped.

load_pct.description: Percentage of rated UPS or equipment load.

on_battery.description: UPS is supplying load from its battery.

water_level_m.description: Water level referenced to defined datum.

soil_moisture_pct.description: Normalized soil moisture value where VWC calibration is unavailable.

disk_fault_count.description: Number of disks in fault state.

safe_entry_state.description: Atmosphere is verified safe for entry.

quantity_current.description: Current lot quantity using the lot-defined unit.

value.description: Generic normalized sensor value; unit defined in point binding.

notes: A point binding may narrow an allowed class but may not change the point meaning.
Reconciled v0.3 points are explicitly marked; they were added only where the v0.2 asset-class tables referenced points missing from section 28.
Canonical units may be converted for display, but storage-unit changes require a schema revision.
